scope: lattice-native/tests/** and lattice-server/src/test/** targeted support review
mode: Source-only, offline; no compilation/test execution/network or source modifications. Artifact write requested by parent.

findings.title: Dormant NBT parser mutates freed Frame after frame-stack growth
findings.status: confirmed dormant native defect; no current production Java invocation
findings.root_cause: parse_impl retains Frame& top, push_frame allocates/copies/frees stack, then nested LIST/COMPOUND list branches decrement top.list_remaining through invalidated reference.

evidence.snippet: std::memcpy(fresh, stack, stack_size * sizeof(Frame)); if (stack != inline_stack) std::free(stack); stack = fresh;

findings.dataflow: Nested input -> parse/validate -> stack migration. 64->128 writes old inline copy and corrupts remaining count; 128->256 or 256->512 writes freed heap storage.
counterevidence: CMakeLists.txt:344-348 includes parser/JNI in shared library, JNIEXPORT exposes parse/free symbols.
NativeChunkSerializer.java has only inflate/deflate declarations and deliberately excludes NBT integration.
No current remote/server input path to NBT parser; privileged plugin/native invocation is not a vulnerability boundary.
findings.remediation: Mutate parent before push_frame, or retain index and reacquire parent after growth. Add sanitizer tests around 64,128,256 list parents. Exclude dormant NBT JNI until safely integrated.

hardening_observations.title: Heightmap short storage/invalid bit width can cause native OOB on direct API input
hardening_observations.details: storage_longs is populated but ignored by kernels; bits not range-checked, mask-array product uses int. Production WorldgenNativeSupport receives Minecraft BitStorage invariants.
hardening_observations.remediation: Check widened mask product, legal bits and required 4096-cell storage length; enforce storage_longs in kernels.

hardening_observations.title: NBT depth wraps at 256
hardening_observations.details: uint8_t depth cannot encode default maxDepth=512; stack capacity still bounds traversal.
hardening_observations.remediation: Widen depth and version index format, or cap advertised supported depth.

hardening_observations.title: Dormant random-tick JNI misses candidates length check
hardening_observations.details: candidateCount checked against output but not input length; no matching NativeRandomTickFilter Java class/callsite.
hardening_observations.remediation: Validate input length or remove dormant JNI.

hardening_observations.title: Native inflate checked exception bypasses intended stream mapping
hardening_observations.details: JNI directly throws DataFormatException; adapter catches RuntimeException only. Correctness issue, no demonstrated security impact.
hardening_observations.remediation: Declare/catch DataFormatException then translate to ZipException.

resolved_questions: Native inflation default cap is 64 MiB, bounded by supplied maxOutputBytes; native inflation is opt-in. Compressed readAllBytes remains uncapped, external .mcc upstream limits not fully reviewed.
NBT index failure paths delete allocations; mutex registry rejects unknown free addresses. Java ownership integration absent. Future wrappers need direct-buffer lifetime/revocation discipline.
NativeRegionFileRead Java synchronizes readAt/close and zeroes handle before nativeClose; normal public wrapper prevents close/read UAF. Destination and positions are validated.
NativeRegionFileRead public Java arbitrary-file reads are not a privilege boundary under arbitrary-JVM-plugin trust model.
Palette JNI input windows validate bits, storage size, offset/count and overflow. Packed SIMD implementations not fully read here.
Noise Cleaner/raw-handle last-use concern passed to world_kernels for ownership review.

dead_code_candidates.details: nativeInflateZlibInto/nativeZlibCompressBound/nativeParseNbtIndex/nativeFreeNbtIndex lack Java declarations; NBT calls outside implementation are dormant JNI/tests. Compiled unused production code, not linker-proven dead.
No NativeRandomTickFilter Java class or production consumer.

test_coverage_observations.details: Only scalar list<int> and depth=1 rejection. No list-container stack-growth tests at 64/128/256, no index-depth 255/256 boundary tests, no JNI direct-buffer ownership tests. Existing tests do not catch NATIVE-IO-01.
test_coverage_observations.recommendation: Construct compound parents through first growth then nested-list parent at heap-capacity transition; run both parse/validate under ASan/UBSan and verify tag counts/consumed bytes. Separately test list parent exactly at 64.

test_coverage_observations.details: Tests compile kernel source directly and omit JNI wrappers; test flags deliberately permit exceptions. CTest success cannot establish JNI length/lifetime safety or complete production-flag parity.
Tests checked_count helper only; no concrete JNI array entrypoints.
Tests only valid correctly sized storage, including 4-bit/9-bit parity. No short storage or invalid bits tests.
Covers malformed header/truncation/checksum/short output/output ceiling; does not cover native Java exception translation or nativeInflateZlibToNewArray.
Range/EOF/idempotent close covered if artifact loads; test returns early when native absent, so passing suite may not exercise native reader. Files confined to @TempDir.
Checksum/config URL/redirect helper and pre-existing symlink cache extraction fixtures use dummy bytes and @TempDir; no actual network server or malicious native loading occurs in reviewed test body.

Explicit env-selected local world fixture reader allocates based on file length and uses unlimitedHeap. This is test harness input, not production player exposure. Mismatches are diagnostic unless lattice.parity.strict=true; do not equate default pass with parity.

Sink search across both test trees found no process spawning/network listener code; actual file writes in matched tests use temporary directories. Most numerical/parity files received only sink scan, not complete semantic review.

coverage_gaps: Generated upstream region/external payload/NBT accounter/SimpleBitStorage deserialization not fully reviewed.
Packed-storage SIMD and light/pathfinder/entity JNI not fully reviewed by this agent.
Heightmap NEON partially read; excluded from full list.
Remaining numerical/parity/benchmark test files only sink-scanned, not fully read.
